name: Flight Ticket Booking App
description: A full flight-booking flow end-to-end with passenger selection, flight class and date pickers, dynamic search, seat selection, and QR/barcode digital ticket generation using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose with MVVM architecture.
highlights: Architected full flight-booking flow end-to-end
Fixed critical data-loading failures in search results
Engineered real-time interactive seat-selection map
Resolved layout-constraint and accessibility issues

name: Music Player App
description: A local audio player integrating ExoPlayer for media playback control, with runtime permission handling for scoped storage access. Features MediaStore-based audio scanning and Compose-based UI.
highlights: Built local audio player with ExoPlayer integration
Implemented runtime permission handling for scoped storage
Designed favorites system with Compose UI
MediaStore-based dynamic audio scanning

name: Restaurant App (Little Lemon)
description: Meta Android Developer Capstone project implementing login validation, email verification, REST API integration, and local Room database caching for offline access to menu data.
highlights: Implemented login validation and email verification
Integrated REST APIs for remote menu data
Solved offline-access with Room database caching
Meta Capstone project - production-grade implementation

name: Appointment Booking App
description: A professional appointment scheduling application with searchable doctor-discovery flow, detailed provider profiles, experience/pricing display, and bottom navigation using MVVM architecture.
highlights: Developed searchable doctor-discovery flow
Built detailed provider profiles with experience/pricing
Applied MVVM to separate UI state from business logic
Responsive UI across multiple screens

name: Car Store App
description: An e-commerce-style product catalog and detail-view flow with search functionality. Designed to demonstrate production-style Android UI/UX conventions using MVVM architecture.
highlights: Designed e-commerce product catalog
Implemented search and filtering
Applied MVVM for consistent state management
Production-style UI/UX implementation
